mainEntity.name: What does it cost to hire a dedicated developer in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Monthly cost depends on role and seniority. Indian dedicated developers usually cost significantly less than equivalent hires in the GCC, UK or Western Europe. Ladder7 keeps pricing affordable and flexible, so share the roles you need and we will propose a team and monthly fee.

mainEntity.name: How quickly can a developer start?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shortlists are typically shared within a week. Start dates depend on the role and the developer's current commitments.

mainEntity.name: Will the developer work in my time zone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Developers align their day for overlap with your core hours. India is 1.5 to 2.5 hours ahead of the Gulf and 3.5 to 5.5 hours ahead of Europe, so a shared working window is easy to arrange.
Yes. Teams run on monthly terms, so you can scale developers up or down as your roadmap changes.

content.text: Questions buyers ask
Frequently asked questions
What does it cost to hire a dedicated developer in India?

Monthly cost depends on role and seniority. Indian dedicated developers usually cost significantly less than equivalent hires in the GCC, UK or Western Europe. Ladder7 keeps pricing affordable and flexible, so share the roles you need and we will propose a team and monthly fee.
How quickly can a developer start?
Shortlists are typically shared within a week. Start dates depend on the role and the developer's current commitments.
Will the developer work in my time zone?

You do. The contract assigns all intellectual property to you, and code lives in your repositories.
